parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The ID of the database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The name of the selected model. You can use only Qwen series models.

parameters.name: Sql
parameters.description: The SQL statement that you want to analyze.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise optimize-sql-by-meta-agent --db-id 1000 --query '是否为慢SQL' --sql select_0_from_table_where_col_=_1 --model qwen-plus --region cn-hangzhou
